-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies WebSocket connectivity to backend.

mca-status.name: mca-status
mca-status.description: Get status of all running MCA processes. Shows appId, status, tool count, idle time, and restart count for each MCA.

mca-kill.name: mca-kill
mca-kill.description: Kill a specific MCA process by appId. The process will be restarted on next use.

params.appId: The appId of the MCA to kill (e.g., 'app:mca-teros-bash-system')

mca-cleanup.name: mca-cleanup
mca-cleanup.description: Trigger cleanup of inactive MCA processes. Kills MCAs that have been idle for too long.

apps-list.name: apps-list
apps-list.description: List all installed apps (MCA instances) with their configuration.

agent-access-list.name: agent-access-list
agent-access-list.description: List all agent app access grants. Shows which agents have access to which apps.

catalog-list.name: catalog-list
catalog-list.description: List all MCAs in the catalog (available MCAs that can be installed).

name: MCA Manager
description: Monitor and manage MCA processes. View running MCAs, kill processes, cleanup inactive, and manage app access.

changelog.notes: Monitor running apps, stop or clean up idle processes, list installed apps, browse the catalog, and review agent access
